answer: Sponsors are capped at 7 vouches per epoch, so one rich backer cannot mint an army of aliases. Each vouch locks 36 POA until the newcomer survives 10 clean epochs, and a farm of 180 fakes must find 180 separate sponsors willing to risk real money on strangers. Without ripple the panel is blind, without trellis the farm is free, and without crystal nobody can prove what happened.
